admission.justification: First-error retention and recount are proved by the named passing final-measure case; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every short form built after a log or detail write failure, including late line failures.
conditions: The first attached error stays and rides every rebuilt short.
Retry failures count as dropped and re-trigger the guard.
exclusions: Successful writes, which carry log instead of logError.
Exception text, paths and numbers, which no logError ever holds.
statement: Every logError is one of the fixed sentences carrying no path, no exception text and no numbers; the first attached error stays and retry failures only count as dropped before the re-guard.
